description: This file contains API interaction functions for a frontend application, providing methods to perform HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) to a backend service, along with specific functions for handling work items such as fetching, creating, and updating status.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or null; throws an error for non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters; processes and returns JSON data.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with specified properties, following backend API spec.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item identified by project ID and item ID.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a full URL for a given API path based on current backend URL.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.name: updateWorkItemStatus
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
